cases.name: fresh
cases.says: the reader has not learned logkey2

cases.name: informed
cases.says: the reader has replayed served and learned logkey2

comment: the served head, signed by logkey2 under the name elsewhere/log instead of the network's origin. Serve it in place of served/checkpoint over the same tiles. A reader holding only trust.cbor (`fresh`) refuses it as log-signature, and so does one that has replayed served (`informed`): the key it learned is named the origin, as the trust file's log key is (SPEC 9.4)

fresh.says: accepted nothing has only the trust file's key

informed.says: named the origin, as the trust file's log key is
